findings.finding: Independent row cutoffs allowed pooled training on another asset's future when timelines were staggered.
findings.resolution: Shared UTC cutoffs, all-asset coverage validation and global fit/inference time guards.

findings.finding: Predict accepted training/calibration rows as future inference; new rolling history could then include their future.
findings.resolution: Reject rows at/before global calibration end, unknown assets, unordered rows and schema mismatch.

findings.finding: Existing MAD was frozen training statistics, not rolling statistics.
findings.resolution: Retain frozen reference; add per-asset 31-prior-observation median/MAD, current point excluded, append after scoring.

findings.finding: Evaluation checked the dataset hash but recomputed splits and did not pair the model binary with metadata.
findings.resolution: Schema v2, paired model hash and partition membership hashes checked before deserialization.

findings.finding: Single-class positive labels could yield misleading perfect AP; metric helper lacked independent input guards.
findings.resolution: Null PR summaries for single-class labels, explicit denominator flags, finite-score/binary-label/bool-alert checks and confusion counts.

findings.finding: A scalar manual threshold applied across incompatible method score scales; repeated UI selection could contaminate confirmatory evaluation.
findings.resolution: Manual scalar is MAD-only, explicitly exploratory, with exported actual per-method thresholds and threshold-source strings; UI warns about post-test selection.

findings.finding: A shared frozen-MAD evidence column could be mistaken for Isolation Forest attribution despite generic caveats.
findings.resolution: Separate rolling evidence and explicitly named forest contextual reference: NOT forest attribution; no causal claim.

findings.finding: Evaluation scope and chart asserted synthetic data even for arbitrary input CSVs.
findings.resolution: Generic held-out-observation scope; only the benchmark generated by the original synthetic generator claims synthetic provenance.

findings.finding: One perfect per-asset AP was 1.0000000000000002 because of arithmetic roundoff.
findings.resolution: Bound only 1e-12 endpoint roundoff; reject genuinely out-of-range values.

retained_design_limits: Calibration positives retained; labels only diagnostic
UI post-hoc selection remains possible and is exploratory
Rolling replay updates prior sensor context but is not persistent streaming
Only easy synthetic spikes; three seeds; no established winner or real-data validity
